observation: First titlebar design was a full-width 36px strip pushing ALL content down; founder rejected it live and asked for main content to reach the top while only the sidebar nav shifts down to clear traffic-lights. Redesigned to a 28px electron-only drag inset inside the sidebar column.

Human concept review had to be a LIVE founder review of the real built desktop app, not the browser component viewer — macOS traffic-lights only render in a real Electron window (hiddenInset), so the browser story cannot show the actual chrome under review.

Unsigned local .app was blocked by `open` (broken ad-hoc signature: 'code has no resources but signature indicates they must be present'); launching the built binary directly bypassed it. Painted proof of an Electron change requires launching the real app, and local-build signing gets in the way.

electron-builder couldn't resolve the `^42.5.0` range from the hoisted worktree node_modules; needed `-c.electronVersion=42.5.0` override to build the .app. Hoisted-monorepo layout breaks electron-builder version auto-detection.

BIGGEST friction: hot-swapping web-dist into the built .app, the web SPA was twice rebuilt from the PRIMARY checkout (stale main, no AV5 files) instead of the worktree — because shell cwd resets between Bash calls — serving a titlebar-less bundle and making the founder think the fix didn't work. Fix: always cd to the worktree before `npm run build`, and grep the compiled CSS/JS to confirm the change is in the bundle before showing the founder.

Electron capturePage() captures web content only (excludes OS traffic-lights); `screencapture` couldn't grab the window (rendered on an uncaptured Space in this environment). No automated screenshot could prove the traffic-light inset — the real proof was the founder's own-machine look.

Founder expanded scope mid-WP: beyond the titlebar, added shell floating-layer polish (content gutter 3px→9px + floating shadow/radius on the main card). SplitView ended net-zero (already at that standard). Scope grew past the WP spec's 'Out of scope: any non-titlebar shell/layout change'.

DesktopTitleBar gated strictly on window.__HYPERIDLE__ returns null in the browser → zero layout impact on the web build, satisfying the AC that the non-Electron build is unaffected. -webkit-app-region applied via .app-region-drag utility class (not inline) since it's absent from React.CSSProperties — captured as @lore in the component.
Both BrowserWindows (local :497 + shared :606) share the same hiddenInset config with matching @lore anchors, keeping the two window boot paths consistent.
